title: HYDRAULIC STEERING BELTS & PULLEYS
summary: Power steering (N40) belt and pulley combinations for four engine setups: 350 C.I.D. with C60 air conditioning, 350 C.I.D. except L46/LT1, L46 & LT1, and the 454 LS5 & LS7. The pump pulley is held by a nut; on 350 engines an extra crankshaft pulley is bolted on to drive the pump belt.

fastening.note: Nut [3] holds the pump pulley [2] on the pump shaft (all four layouts).
350 C.I.D. layouts (with C60, and except L46 & LT1): bolt [4] fastens the pulley assembly [5] to the crankshaft pulley.

Belt [1] runs from the crankshaft pulley ([5] on 350 C.I.D.) to the pump pulley [2]. In the LS5 & LS7 layout belt [6] runs over the generator pulley and down past the P/S pump. Belt strand tension: see UPC 6.

notes: Views: 350 C.I.D. W/RPO C60; 350 C.I.D. EXC RPO'S L46 & LT1; RPO L46 & LT1; RPO LS5 & LS7.
notes_internal: Item 5 / bolt 4 shown only in the two 350 C.I.D. views; not shown in the L46/LT1 and LS5/LS7 views.
Belt [6] routing in the LS5/LS7 view: drawn from the generator pulley down toward the pump; exact pulleys it rides on are not clear.
